title: Hunts FH-032S: Plug live partner state and the finale broadcast into route health

source.ref: Split from FH-032 (2026-11-16): route health shipped over the tables on main; FH-029 and FH-031 were being built in parallel and are not read yet.

detail:
Route health (lib/hunts/route-health.ts) decides which Spaces are venues in one function, activeVenues, from the hunt_partners rows with the authz liveness rule, and reports the Hunt outbox as its message status. Owed by an agent once FH-029 and FH-031 are on main: read the live partner state from lib/hunts/partners.ts in activeVenues (pinned terms, the named steward, a withdrawn venue keeps its historic counts and drops from the active list), and add the finale broadcast state from lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts beside the outbox counts on /hunts/<slug>/health. Also link the two pages (/hunts/<slug>/health for organisers, /hunts/<slug>/report for venue staff) from the Trail's manage screen. Done when: a venue withdrawn through the partner flow leaves the organiser's active venue list on the next read while its past counts still reconcile, and the organiser sees whether the finale broadcast went out. Requires: FH-029, FH-031, FH-032. Owner role: Operations and analytics.

2026-11-18: closed by its probe. activeVenues in lib/hunts/route-health.ts now uses partnerLive from lib/hunts/partners.ts, so a withdrawn or suspended venue leaves the organiser's active list on the next read, and buildRouteHealth lists its past counts under formerVenues so the totals still reconcile (pinned in route-health.test.ts). The store reads the current version's finale (parseFinale), the host Event's title and state, and the outbox rows addressed to finaleBroadcastAggregate(eventId) (lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts); /hunts/<slug>/health shows them beside the outbox counts and lists venues that left. The Trail editor's publish step links Route health and Venue report once the Trail is live and claims are on. Not surfaced here: a partner's pinned terms version and named steward (the venue rows keep their FH-032 shape). Nothing queues a finale notice yet, so the finale counts read zero until a producer uses finaleBroadcastAggregate; that is carried on FH-031T.
